settings_appearance_desc: Language, theme and the size of the interface.
settings_numbers_desc: How numbers look, and the values new builds and items start with.
settings_mcp_desc: A local server that lets an AI client on this computer read and edit the open build.
settings_experimental_desc: Features that are still being tested. They can change or go away.
settings_updates_desc: The version you have, and new releases.
settings_diagnostics_desc: Logs and a report file for bug reports.
settings_language_hint: System follows your operating system. Game data from Path of Building stays in English.
settings_contrast_hint: Lifts the grey text tones. Auto follows the OS setting.
settings_scale_hint: Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- step it, Ctrl+0 resets.
settings_scale_limited: The window fits {applied} at most. Make it larger to use {wanted}.
settings_numbers_note: Applied to the calculation engine now and re-applied on every start. Path of Building's own settings file is never touched.
settings_numbers_waiting: These settings are available once the calculation engine has started.
settings_mcp_enable_hint: An AI client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can read and edit the open build. Local only.
experimental_enable_hint: A small, fast model answers pick-one questions for the assistant, such as which tools it needs. Every number still comes from Path of Building. While this is off, nothing is sent.
experimental_backend_hint: TypeSafe Jev and OpenRouter run in the cloud with your own key. OpenRouter serves Kev 4B and Jev. Kev (local) is the open model on your own GPU.
experimental_key_optional: Optional. Only a server started with KEV_API_KEY needs one.
experimental_address_hint: Leave both empty for the defaults. The -latest model follows new releases; enter a version number to keep answers stable.
experimental_openrouter_models: Leave both empty for Kev 4B (jaredpalmer/kev-4b). Enter ~typesafe/jev-latest as the model to use Jev with the same key.
experimental_routing_hint: Before each message, the decision model picks the tools the assistant will likely need and loads them. It also ranks the results of the assistant's tool search.
experimental_not_ready: Add a key or start the server first.
experimental_privacy: With tool routing on, your last two messages to the assistant and the tool descriptions go to the decision model. The build itself is not sent.
settings_version_hint: Checked once shortly after start. Installing replaces the app and needs a restart.
settings_report_hint: A text file with app details and recent logs, for attaching to an issue. Paths, tokens and API keys are masked.
boot_run_sync: Vendor Path of Building with this command, then restart:
welcome_question: Which game are you building for?
welcome_hint: Each game runs its own Path of Building. You can switch any time from the title bar.
game_switch_message: The open build has unsaved changes. Switch to {game} anyway?
status_workers_title: Extra PoB engines that share node-power and gem-DPS scoring
status_mcp_title: MCP server for AI clients is on (configure in Options)
sidebar_rename_title: Click to rename. The file is renamed with it.
sidebar_loadout_title: Loadout: a matching tree, item set, skill set and config set
sidebar_loadout_delete_title: Delete loadout (removes its tree, item, skill and config sets)
sidebar_level_auto_on: Level follows the points spent (PoB's Auto mode). Click for Manual.
sidebar_level_auto_off: Set the level from the points spent, as PoB's Auto mode does
sidebar_weapon_set_title: Each weapon set holds up to {max} passives. Only the larger set counts against your passive points.
sidebar_manage_beasts_title: Choose which beasts this build owns, so a Companion gem can use them
sidebar_manage_spectres_title: Choose which spectres this build owns, so a Raise Spectre gem can use them
update_download_title: A package install is replaced by its package manager, not by the app
notes_edit_title: Edit the notes as text, with the colour codes shown
notes_placeholder: Notes are saved with the build.
notes_empty: No notes. Choose Edit to add some.
calcs_buff_help: What these numbers assume. Unbuffed is standing in town. Buffed adds your auras. In combat adds charges. Effective DPS adds the enemy. The sidebar always shows Effective DPS.
provider_intro_agents: Each coding agent runs on this computer, signed in to your own account, so your plan's usage limits apply. The app starts the program and never sees your login, and the agent can only use the build's tools. Ollama runs a model on your own machine.
settings_assistant_desc: Where the assistant's answers come from. Coding agents run on this computer, signed in to your own plan; Ollama runs a model locally.
assistant_terminal_install: A terminal window is running: {command}. This page updates when it finishes.
assistant_terminal_login: A terminal window is running: {command}. Finish signing in there; this page updates when you are done.
assistant_install_hint: Install opens a terminal and runs the vendor's own installer:
assistant_models_need_setup: Set up {name} to see its models.
assistant_model_in_use: In use, so it stays in the list
assistant_ask_first_hint: Off: the assistant changes the build as it works, and each reply that changed something ends with Keep and Undo. On: every change also waits for you to approve it.
assistant_download_note: Google's own Antigravity agent, downloaded from Google and checked against its published fingerprint before it is unpacked. Each start unpacks about 1 GB of temporary files, which the app clears.
assistant_no_build: {name} has no build for this computer.
assistant_signing_in: Finish signing in in your browser.
provider_path_hint: Full path to the {name} program, if it is not on your PATH. Leave blank to search for it.
provider_base_hint: Base URL. Leave blank for the default ({base}).
minions_recommended_title: Only the ones PoB marks as worth using
minions_note_beast: A beast in the library does nothing until a Companion gem in the build is set to it.
minions_note_spectre: A spectre in the library does nothing until a Raise Spectre gem in the build is set to it.
buy_unique_note: Searches for {name} by name, with the mods you tick.
buy_mod_unsearchable: The trade site has no filter for this mod
buy_no_mods: This item has no mods to search for.
buy_opened: Opened in your browser. The link is on your clipboard too.
party_import_placeholder: Support build's share code or link (exported with 'Export support' enabled)
party_append_title: Append to the current party lists instead of replacing them (curses still replace)
party_take_title: Take only one kind of support from the imported build
party_disable_title: Turn the party's effects off without losing the pasted data. Rebuild all puts them back.
party_rebuild_title: Reparse all boxes after manual edits
party_export_title: Include this build's own auras/curses/buffs when exporting its share code, so a party member can import them here
party_advanced_title: Show and edit the raw parsed buffers
party_box_auras_hint: Auras with the highest effect take priority
party_box_curses_hint: Your own curses take priority over a support's
config_relevant_only_title: Hide options PoB deems irrelevant to this build's skills and gear (set options always show)
config_browse_title: Browse supported mod lines from tree nodes and item mods
config_mods_placeholder: One modifier per line, e.g. +50 to maximum Life
trader_subtitle: A weighted trade search for every slot. Results open in your browser.
trader_listings_title: Which listings the search should return
trader_weight_title: How much this stat counts against the others
trader_jewels_title: Which kind of jewel the socket rows should search for
trader_note: Prices, live results and whisper messages need a Path of Exile account login, which this app does not have. Path of Building calls the same thing No Session Mode.
timeless_conqueror_title: Conqueror, which decides the keystone the jewel grants
timeless_taken_only_title: Only score passives you have taken, or ones within a few points of your tree
timeless_reach_title: Also score unallocated passives this many points away
timeless_weight_title: Weight: how much this counts towards a seed's score
timeless_weight2_title: Weight for the node's second stat roll
timeless_min_title: Reject a seed that does not reach this much of this node
timeless_wanted_empty: Pick from the left. A seed scores by the weights you set here.
timeless_pick_hint: click to pick, shift-click for a run
timeless_no_results: No seed produces what you asked for in that socket.
timeless_trade_title: Open a pathofexile.com trade search for these seeds
compare_only_diff_title: Hide anything the two builds have in common
compare_paste_placeholder: Paste a build code or a pobb.in link…
compare_empty: Load a second build to compare this one against.
compare_empty_hint: It runs through the same calculator as the open build, so every number lines up. Nothing you do here changes the comparison build.
compare_same_numbers: The two builds produce the same numbers.
compare_gained: passives they take that you do not
compare_lost: passives you take that they do not
compare_copy_tree: Copy their tree into my build
compare_copy_tree_hint: The copy lands as a new tree on the Tree tab, where the compare overlay draws what to take and what to drop.
compare_buy_similar_title: Search the trade site for items like theirs
compare_use_theirs_title: Equip their item in this slot
compare_same_items: Both builds wear the same items.
compare_same_skills: Both builds use the same skills.
compare_same_config: Both builds are configured the same way.
compare_tree_added: Added "{title}" as tree {index}. Open the Tree tab to compare it against your own.
skills_copy_group_title: Copy the selected group as text (PoB-compatible)
skills_paste_group_title: Paste a group copied from PoB or this app
skills_default_level_title: Level given to newly added gems
skills_quality_title: Quality given to newly added gems
skills_sort_by_title: Order the gem picker by what each gem would do for this build
skills_sort_field_title: Which number the gem picker sorts on
skills_supports_title: Which support gems the picker offers
skills_legacy_title: Offer gems that are no longer obtainable
skills_count_title: How many copies of this item-granted skill apply
skills_delete_group_blocked: This group comes with an item or a mechanic and cannot be deleted; change the item instead
skills_add_gem: Add a gem… (name, or tag like 'projectile')
skills_dps_title: Score every valid support by its DPS impact and sort by it (first run takes a moment)
skills_cannot_support: Cannot support this group's active skill
skills_no_selection: Select or create a socket group.
skills_mark_mechanic: {source}: a mechanic PoB calculates, not a skill
skills_mark_node: Granted by the passive {node}; not a socketed gem
skills_mark_item_duplicate: . Same skill as group {source}, which carries the supports
opt_open_build: Open a build to review it.
opt_points_title: Passive points spent (the larger weapon set counts), budget at level {level}
opt_charms_title: Charms equipped; slots come from the belt
opt_run_title: Resistances stay at 75, requirements stay met, movement speed is kept. Nothing changes until you apply.
opt_plan_budget_title: How many passive points to spend
chat_resize_title: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
chat_no_provider_blurb: The assistant uses a coding agent on this computer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode or Antigravity), signed in to your own plan, or a model you run with Ollama.
chat_edit_resend: Edit and send again. Replies after it are discarded.
chat_copy_details_run_title: Copy this run's details, for a bug report
chat_copy_details_error_title: Copy the error with the run around it, for a bug report
chat_open_log_title: Show the assistant log file. Every run is appended to it.
chat_speed_fast_desc: Quicker replies. Uses more of your plan.
chat_changes_auto_desc: Changes apply as the assistant works. Undo a whole reply in one click.
chat_changes_supervised_desc: Each change waits for your approval.
chat_context_used: {percent}% of the context window used ({used} of {size} tokens)
chat_context_processed: {total} tokens processed in this chat, {cached} from cache
chat_warm_title: Ollama loads a model on first use; it is loaded and its prompt cached ahead of your first message.
tree_compare_title: Overlay another tree: green = allocate to match it, red = remove to match it
tree_allocate_into_title: Where a click allocates passives. Alt + scroll over the tree also changes it.
tree_ascendancy_title: Center on the ascendancy ring, where its 8 points are spent (a)
tree_ascendancy_none: Pick an ascendancy in the sidebar first
tree_timeless_title: Find a timeless jewel seed that makes the passives you want
tree_stat_diff_title: Show what allocating or removing a node changes, in its tooltip (Ctrl+D)
tree_power_title: Show node power (p): estimated value of each unallocated node
tree_power_depth_title: Max path length to score (lower = faster)
tree_power_note_title: Time to score every eligible node, and how many engines shared the work
tree_weapon_set_badge: Allocating into weapon set {set} · Alt + scroll to change
tree_version_banner: This tree uses passive tree version {current}; the current game version is {latest}. Converting keeps the old tree as a separate spec; passives that no longer exist are dropped.
tree_no_node_improves: No unallocated node improves this stat within the depth limit.
tree_mastery_taken: Taken by another mastery of this kind
tree_class_change_body: Switching to {ascendancy} changes your class to {className}. Your tree is not connected to that class's start, so it would be reset.
tree_click_allocate: click to allocate · hold Shift to trace
items_paste_hint: Paste an item to compare (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V)
items_paste_empty: The clipboard is empty. Copy an item first, or use New item from text.
items_paste_failed: Could not read the clipboard. Use New item from text to paste manually. {error}
items_text_unrecognized: Path of Building cannot read this as an item. Check the rarity and base type lines.
items_preview_note: This item has not been added to your build. Leaving Items discards the preview.
items_preview_no_slot: No compatible active slot. You can still add this item to the build unequipped.
items_crafted_modifiers_hint: Edit generated modifiers using the prefix and suffix controls above. Custom modifiers can be edited here.
items_trader_title: A weighted trade search for every slot at once
items_stat_diff_title: Show what removing or swapping an item changes, in its tooltip (Ctrl+D)
items_jewel_sockets_title: Jewel sockets allocated on the tree; each takes a jewel
items_shared_title: Shared items are available in every build. Items from PoB's own settings show here too; ones you add are kept by this app.
items_shared_equip_title: Copy into this build and equip
items_buy_similar_title: Search the trade site for items like this one
items_find_upgrades_title: Open the Trader with this slot highlighted
items_cluster_passives_title: How many passives the jewel adds
items_edit_placeholder:
Rarity: Rare
Item name
Base Type
...mod lines...
import_recent_desc: Builds you opened in this app, newest first.
import_pob_desc: Build files (.xml) in Path of Building's own folder. This app and Path of Building open and save the same files.
import_planner_reset_title: Use the game's default folder again
import_planner_desc: Files from the game's own Build Planner, grouped by the author written in each file. Opening one makes a new build here and does not change the file.
import_folder_hint: It starts empty. Hover a build and use its folder button to move it in or out.
import_planner_missing: Folder not found. Use Browse to pick the game's BuildPlanner folder.
import_author_group_title: Set the author written in these files
import_gb_rename_title: Rename (the name inside the file; the file keeps its own)
import_code_placeholder: Share code, build XML, or a link (pobb.in, Maxroll, Mobalytics, poe.ninja, poe2db, Pastebin, Rentry)
import_no_ninja_build: poe.ninja has no build for this character
import_ninja_blurb: Imports the build poe.ninja saved for a character. poe.ninja saves builds only for the characters on its ladders, which leaves out low-level and inactive characters.
import_ggg_blurb: Imports a character's passive tree, items and gems into a new build. The account's profile and Characters tab must be public on pathofexile.com.
import_moba_pob_blurb: The author's own PoB build: tree, items and gems. The best way to load it here.
import_moba_planner_blurb: For the game's own planner. Saved flat into {folder}.
import_moba_planner_warning: Opening one here loses any tree nodes the author did not path from the class start.
import_link_title: Upload the code and copy the link
import_export_planner_title: A file the game's Build Planner can import
import_folder_created: Created folder {name}. Use the folder button on a build to put it there.
import_clipboard_failed: Could not use the clipboard ({error}). The {what} is in the box above.
import_autosave_restored: Autosave restored — use Save to write it to disk
app_safe_mode: Safe mode: the last build was not reopened
app_recover_message: PoB Redux closed unexpectedly while {build} was open. If reopening it closes the app again, choose Start empty; the build is then saved to your builds folder as a recovered copy.
app_recovered_failed: Could not save the recovered build: {error}
link_open_message: The open build has unsaved changes. Open the linked build anyway?
chat_checkpoint_failed: Could not checkpoint the build, so this reply's changes cannot be undone: {error}
chat_output_limit: The reply hit the model's output limit and was cut off.
chat_content_filter: The provider's content filter stopped the reply.
chat_paused_steps: Paused after {steps} tool steps without finishing.
items_equipment_hint: Hover to inspect · Click to edit
